name: cmux.terminal.backend/1
docs: Bytes mode (ghostty-next-switch.md, cloud-app.md): the backend carries raw terminal bytes; the local session host parses them and owns snapshots and the journal. An app backend runs as the app's server (implements with server: true) and needs the restricted scope terminal:backend. Rust trait TerminalBackend.

props.target: string (a backend-defined id, for example a cloud machine id)

kinds.description: Target kinds this implementation serves; the registry ids are app:<app>/<kind>. Default deny: a kind not listed is never routed here.

status: draft: shapes chosen by the ghostty-next lead (2026-10-04); refined with the cmux Cloud and third-party sample backends before the interface is public
